verdict.rationale: The evidence pack lists features that by name imply background, unattended operation: Monitors, Watchdog (automated detection), Bits AI, and Kubernetes Autoscaling. However, these entries are bare titles with no content showing that users can define and run their own autonomous automations or agents. Missing for 10: documentation of user-configurable automations/workflows, evidence of Bits AI acting autonomously in the background, trigger/action details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
